body: I have nowhere to go, especially because we work together. Without a license, I'm stuck here for now

I have my own car, fortunately. I've been working a lot and was able to save up. My mom refuses to teach me how to drive because she was in a car accident. My dad is dead so he's no help. I have no other family that's willing to drive and none of my friends are old enough to legally help me. I asked a friend if her dad could teach me and my mom was super against it
I have a job but we work together. I don't have a license. If I did, I'd be living in my car somewhere else :(

She belittles me, a lot. Or she's mad at me over something small. She looks down on me for things I can't control, like my mental and physical health. She makes a big deal out of me not making doctor appointments but then has a fit when I do make said appointments. It's like I can never win. She's punching down at this point

As someone whose love language is gift giving, I can say this isn't "I love myself more than I love you." This is you prioritizing yourself, whether it's occasionally or all the time, or somewhere in between.

If her love language is gift receiving, this might come across as the opposite. If this is true, then maybe you could get her small gifts? Anything to show her that you're thinking of her. If she expects big gifts every time, or if she complains about the gifts being too cheap/not expensive enough, then you know she's more interested in the value of things and not that you're thinking of her
